name: Skilled Worker visa
title: Skilled Worker Visa UK | Applications & Extensions | UVS
description: Skilled Worker visa applications, extensions and changes of employer, with Certificate of Sponsorship and salary checks. IAA-regulated, Manchester.

faqs.a: Yes, but you need to make a new application before you start the new job, with a Certificate of Sponsorship from the new employer.

faqs.q: Can my family come with me?
faqs.a: Your partner and children can usually apply as dependants. Some roles have restrictions, so we check this for your case.
